note: 学习目标与理解测验（写讲稿前定，审查与测验都对照它）。题目以迁移题为主，干扰项来自真实误解；前测、看片、后测、讲回来。AI 学生只用来筛题，最终以真人盲测为准（edu_videos/_shared/research/explainer_benchmark.md）。 v5（2026-11-09）：Q5 由捷径学习题换成过拟合迁移题；目标句号重挂。

objectives.zh: 能用自己的话说出过拟合是什么：在手里的数据上表现很好，换到新数据就不行，因为记住了噪声和巧合
objectives.en: Explain overfitting in their own words: great on the data you have, poor on new data, because it memorized noise and coincidences

objectives.zh: 会用两种误差判断：练习（训练）误差低、考试（测试）误差高就是过拟合的信号；两种都高是欠拟合
objectives.en: Diagnose with two errors: low training error with high test error signals overfitting; both high is underfitting

objectives.zh: 说得出为什么太复杂的模型会过拟合：它的数字多到能把每个点原样存下，连噪声也一起记住
objectives.en: Say why an overly complex model overfits: it has enough numbers to store every point as is, noise included

objectives.zh: 知道三种对策各解决什么：验证集（及早发现、挑模型）、更多更多样的数据、限制复杂度（正则化）
objectives.en: Know what each fix does: a validation set, more and more varied data, limiting complexity (regularization)

objectives.zh: 不被教歪：不是越简单越好；训练误差为零不等于好模型
objectives.en: Avoid the misconceptions: simpler is not always better; zero training error is not a good model

quiz.zh: 一个识别垃圾邮件的模型，在训练用的邮件上准确率 99%，上线后对新邮件只有 70%。最可能是什么问题？
quiz.en: A spam filter is 99% accurate on its training emails but only 70% on new emails after launch. What is the most likely problem?

zh: A 欠拟合：模型太简单
B 过拟合：记住了训练邮件的特点，没学到通用规律
C 新邮件太少，统计不准
D 训练准确率越高越好，这不是问题
en: A Underfitting: the model is too simple
B Overfitting: it memorized quirks of the training emails
C Too few new emails to measure
D Higher training accuracy is always better, so no problem

misconception_choices.A: 把两种误差的组合弄反

quiz.zh: 为了避免过拟合，是不是应该总用最简单的模型？
quiz.en: To avoid overfitting, should you always use the simplest possible model?

zh: B 不是，太简单会欠拟合，要找练习和考试都好的中间那一段
D 不是，应该用最复杂的模型再多训练
en: A Yes, simpler is always safer
B No. Too simple underfits; look for the middle where both errors are low
C Yes, as long as there is enough data
D No, use the most complex model and train longer

quiz.zh: 用十个点训练两个模型：一个有 4 个可调的数字，一个有 10 个。哪个更可能过拟合？为什么？
quiz.en: Two models are trained on ten points: one has 4 adjustable numbers, the other has 10. Which is more likely to overfit, and why?

answer_key.zh: 10 个数字的那个；它的数字多到能把十个点原样记下，连噪声也记住了
answer_key.en: The one with 10; it has enough numbers to store all ten points exactly, noise included

quiz.zh: 你在调一个模型，想在不碰最终测试集的前提下尽早发现过拟合，应该怎么做？
quiz.en: You are tuning a model and want to catch overfitting early without touching the final test set. What should you do?

zh: B 每次都用测试集挑模型
C 另留一份验证集来挑模型、观察误差
D 把测试集也加进训练
en: A Watch the training error only
B Use the test set to pick the model each time
C Hold out a validation set to choose models and watch its error
D Add the test set to the training data

quiz.zh: 有人想从过去 20 天的股价里找规律，用了一条能穿过全部 20 个点的复杂曲线，练习误差是零。你对它预测明天的股价有信心吗？为什么？
quiz.en: Someone fits a complicated curve that passes through all 20 of the last 20 days' stock prices; its practice error is zero. How confident are you in its prediction for tomorrow, and why?

answer_key.zh: 可能认不出来：它学的可能是「草地 = 牛」这种只在训练数据里成立的巧合（捷径学习，过拟合的近亲）
answer_key.en: It may fail to recognize it: it may have learned 'grass = cow', a coincidence that only holds in the training data (shortcut learning, a cousin of overfitting)

answer.zh: 没信心：曲线把每天的随机涨跌（噪声）也记住了，噪声不会重演，这正是过拟合；练习误差为零不等于预测准。
answer.en: Not confident: the curve has memorized each day's random ups and downs (noise), which won't repeat — that's overfitting; zero practice error doesn't mean good predictions.

prompt.zh: 请用两三句话，给一个没学过 AI 的朋友解释什么是过拟合。
prompt.en: In two or three sentences, explain overfitting to a friend who has never studied AI.

propositions: 原因是记住了噪声 / 巧合 / 细节，而不是规律
（加分）和模型太复杂或数据太少有关
（加分）用验证集或测试数据发现

pass_rule: 每个学习目标至少有一道题，真人后测正确率比前测提升、且 ≥ 2/3 的人答对；讲回来覆盖前三条要点、不出现误解。AI 学生结果只用于改题与找讲稿漏洞，不作过关依据。
